notes: Extracted from Datavideo's official SE-3200 datasheet PDF (rear-panel I/O diagram + spec table), cross-checked against Markertek and B&H spec listings. Video I/O: 8x SDI in + 4x HDMI in (12 total inputs), 6x SDI out + 3x HDMI out (9 total outputs); one of the 6 SDI outputs is a fixed down-converted SD output, the rest are assignable (Multiview/PGM/PVW/inputs/stills/Flex). SDI is native 1080p60 (3G-SDI) per the datasheet overview ("real Full native 1080p/60 (3G)"); HDMI version/grade is not stated on any source I could find, so HDMI grade is omitted rather than guessed. Audio: 4x XLR balanced analog in (can alternatively carry 2x AES/EBU pairs per Markertek) and 2x XLR balanced analog out, plus embedded digital audio (2ch in/4ch out) - embedded audio is not a separate physical port. Control: single DB9 "RS-232/422 REMOTE" port is software-selectable between RS-232 and RS-422 (modeled as rs232 with rs422 in accepts); a separate front-panel DB9 "CONSOLE" port links the main unit to its detachable control-panel keyboard (not a general-purpose remote port). Tally output is a D-sub 25-pin connector; DB25 isn't in the provided connector enum, so it was mapped to "rs232" as the closest D-sub serial id - this is an approximation, not a literal serial port. GPI input is mentioned on some third-party listings but could not be confirmed on the official datasheet/rear-panel diagram, so it was omitted. Power: external DC power supply, 12V/69W, via a locking DC barrel connector (Datavideo's standard 5.5mm/2.5mm locking barrel per their power-adapter FAQ and store listing) - two power bricks ("2x AD Switch DC 12V") are included, likely one for the main unit and one for the control panel, but the datasheet only diagrams a single DC IN 12V jack on the main unit rear panel. Ethernet is used for DVIP control and MJPEG/H.264 streaming; no link-speed spec was published, so eth-100m is a reasonable but unconfirmed assumption for a switcher of this vintage (2022 datasheet revision). Dimensions: 433 x 312 x 76mm (control surface), 432 x 252 x 88mm (2RU main unit), 4kg total.

ports.name: SDI OUT 6 (Down-converted)
ports.note: One of the 6 SDI outputs is a fixed down-converted (SD) output; the remaining 5 are assignable HD-3G outputs.

ports.name: REF IN
ports.note: Genlock/reference input (analog tri-level or black burst), loop-through

ports.name: AUDIO IN 1
ports.note: Balanced analog audio input; 4 total, can also carry 2x AES/EBU pairs

ports.name: AUDIO OUT 1
ports.note: Balanced analog de-embedded audio output; 2 total

ports.name: RS-232/422 REMOTE
ports.note: Software-selectable RS-232 or RS-422 on a single DB9 port; DB9-to-DB9 cable included

ports.name: CONSOLE
ports.note: Front-panel DB9 port connecting the main unit to the separate control-surface keyboard panel

ports.name: ETHERNET
ports.note: Used for DVIP remote control, MJPEG/H.264 streaming, and firmware updates; link speed not explicitly stated, assumed 100M-class control/streaming NIC

ports.name: USB FW UPGRADE
ports.note: USB port for firmware upgrade only; USB version not specified

ports.name: TALLY OUT
ports.note: D-sub 25-pin dual-color tally output; DB25 not in the connector list, mapped to closest serial D-sub connector id

ports.name: DC IN 12V
ports.note: 12V DC input via external locking power adapter (2x 'AD Switch DC 12V' supplied, 69W); connector is a locking barrel/coaxial DC jack, not a standard AC inlet
